kurz: Cream with a splash of buttermilk turns thick and mildly tangy overnight at room temperature.
bild_im_kopf: Like a sourdough for cream: a spoonful of the old starts the new.
haltbarkeit: Up to about a month in the fridge.
verwendung: For sauces: it does not curdle when boiled, because it has so much fat.
On tarte flambée, with soups, with desserts.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Stir cream and buttermilk together in the jar
schluesselmomente.warum: The buttermilk brings lactic acid bacteria.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Cover and leave at room temperature for 12–24 hours
schluesselmomente.warum: The bacteria make lactic acid, which thickens the protein in the cream, along with typical buttery aromas.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Once it is thick, chill it
schluesselmomente.warum: Cold slows the bacteria and makes it firmer still.
